title: Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts — Elapsed Term Count by Contract Form on Kept-Vehicle Cancellations
content:
**Clause.** For a kept-vehicle refund on a Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts contract, the elapsed days of the term are the calendar days from the term start date to the effective date. They are counted as the contract form of the coverage level sets:
- **Kessler Shield Exclusionary or Kessler Shield Exclusionary Wrap form:** in whole 30-day periods completed. A part period is not counted. The elapsed days are 30 for each whole period.
- **Kessler Shield Preferred or Kessler Shield Select form:** in 30-day periods, with a started period counted as a whole one. The elapsed days are 30 for each period begun.
- **Otherwise** (Kessler Shield Powertrain and Powertrain Plus): the calendar days as counted.

**Worked counts (hypothetical elapsed calendar days).**

| Calendar days elapsed | Exclusionary / Exclusionary Wrap | Preferred / Select | Powertrain / Powertrain Plus |
|---|---|---|---|
| 95 | 90 (3 whole periods) | 120 (4 periods begun) | 95 |
| 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| 29 | 0 | 30 | 29 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
